query:
EVALUATE
TOPN (
    10,
    FILTER (
        SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
            'Products Details'[Product Name],
            'Products Details'[Products Category],
            TREATAS ( { 2020 }, 'Calender'[Year] ),
            "Sales", [Total Sales],
            "Profit", [Total Profit]
        ),
        [Profit] < 0
    ),
    [Profit], ASC
)
ORDER BY [Profit]
